$comment: Layout QA classifier transitions — confidence + reason per rule. Currently used as documentation of intent. Override-able by passing as the `rules` argument to tools.layout_qa.classifier.classify_entries; otherwise DEFAULT_RULES in that module is used.

INITIAL_LABEL_CHARACTER.trigger: FFFF + (next is FFFF | next FFFE is SCENARIO | next FFFE is bullet)
INITIAL_LABEL_CHARACTER.reason: FFFF with next entry also FFFF — nameplate in roster

INITIAL_LABEL_LOCATION.trigger: FFFF + next is FFFE without SCENARIO/bullet
INITIAL_LABEL_LOCATION.reason: last FFFF before first FFFE — location title

INITIAL_SCENARIO.reason: SCENARIO marker matched at first FFFE entry

INITIAL_OBJECTIVE.reason: bullet prefix at first FFFE entry

INITIAL_TO_SCENE_DIALOGUE.reason: FFFE with no SCENARIO/bullet — assumed dialogue (last FFFF was location)

INTRO_TO_SCENE_LOCATION.reason: first FFFF after SCENARIO intro = location label

OBJECTIVE_TO_SCENE_LOCATION.reason: first FFFF after objectives = location label

SCENE_LOCATION.reason: FFFF entry inside SCENE_12X4 state (mid-file location)
